Contents: Exact values behind the figures: patient-level coverage, interval width and errors of the prediction intervals, by method, dataset and subgroup.

Overall patient-level coverage (%) of the prediction intervals Intervals were calibrated on the VitalDB calibration patients and, for MIMIC-III, applied unchanged. Numbers of patients in parentheses. Reference without PPG: a split conformal interval around the training median (115.6 mmHg), VitalDB test, nominal 90%: coverage 90.1 (89.2–90.9), median width 65.0 mmHg.

Patient-level coverage (%) of nominal 90% SBP intervals by true and by predicted SBP, VitalDB test patients, feature model Shrinkage model: coverage expected if the estimate equals a + b × true SBP plus a normal error (Section S1.10). Group-wise: calibrated within bands of predicted SBP.

Recalibration with MIMIC-III patients, feature model, nominal 90% SBP intervals (200 random draws) Offset corrected: estimates and quantiles first shifted by their mean error in the calibration patients (exploratory). At SBP ≥ 160 mmHg, two measures are shown: the share of such segments covered, pooled over patients, and the patient-level coverage (the mean over patients of each patient's share). With 5 patients the interval is unlimited, so coverage is not shown.

Withholding SBP estimates with wide CQR intervals, feature model Thresholds were chosen on the VitalDB calibration patients to keep 10%, 20%, …, 100% of their segments. Values are not shown when fewer than 1% of segments were kept.

Shrinkage corrected: the estimate was mapped back by (estimate − a)/b with a and b from the calibration patients (Section S1.10), and a split conformal interval was built around it. MAE is over segments, with patients resampled; coverage is per patient, with each patient's pair of values kept together. Differences in coverage are in percentage points.
